observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: outdoor stage at a school or public event
observation.formation_and_space: initially a line, then moving in unison, maintaining a line formation
observation.posture: torso upright or slightly bent forward, knees bent, weight shifted between feet
observation.footwork: rhythmic stomping and slapping of boots, synchronized with the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms swing, clap, or salute; hands strike the boots
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal hip movement, torso remains relatively stable while legs and arms are active
observation.costume_and_props: matching blue jumpsuits and black rubber boots
observation.cannot_infer: low resolution makes it difficult to see the exact point of contact between hands and boots, and the speed of the footwork is hard to track precisely

signature_moments.what: synchronized stomping and slapping of boots while in a line formation
saluting while standing in a line, followed by a rhythmic sequence of stomps and kicks
saluting in unison, followed by a rhythmic sequence of stomps and kicks
saluting in unison, followed by a rhythmic sequence of stomps and kicks
